newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes hold steady.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes hold steady.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes held steady on Tuesday amid poor demand and thin liquidity, traders said.
A supplier said he fixed a 380-cst grade parcel at $96 per tonne on Monday but did not expect better prices today. "Enquiries are very few today.," said the supplier.
The 380-cst grade was quoted by majors at about $96/$98 per tonne while the 180-cst grade was at $102/$104.
MDO and gas oil were quoted $175/$177 and $184/$186 per tonne respectively.
